Add a case that reads the `message_start` frame and checks both fields are present and null. As per coding guidelines: “A provider-harness case for every wire-visible change.”

**Required benchmark is missing** This changes `message_start` serialization, but adds no benchmark for that branch. `AGENTS.md` requires request-path changes to include a `Benchmark*` in the existing test file and before/after `ns/op` and `allocs/op` results from `-benchmem`. The PR description provides neither results nor an exemption. Add a focused benchmark in `invoke_test.go` and record the results before merging. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/b0d094c7f898d6acff6930175d8752eb44f41f13/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

** Minor** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Add the required request-path benchmark evidence for this stream change.** The Created stream branch now adds two fields to every `message_start` event (`core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go:2248-2249`). AGENTS.md requires request-path streaming changes to ship a `Benchmark*` in the existing `_test.go` file, run with `-benchmem`. The PR body must then record allocs/op and ns/op before and after. Neither the diff nor the PR body does this, and the body does not explain why the change cannot be benchmarked. Add a benchmark for the stream conversion path in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`. Record the before and after `-benchmem` results in the PR body. If benchmarking is not possible, state the reason in the PR body.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the fix (null stop_reason and stop_sequence on the InvokeModel stream message_start event) and matches the changeset: the invoke.go change, its regression test, the e2e test, and the changelog entry. It is specific and conventional.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description covers the summary, changes, type of change, affected areas, how to test, breaking changes, and related issues. It explains the problem and the fix clearly. Gaps: the template's Security considerations and Checklist sections are missing. The How to test section has no expected outcome beyond a brief note. The e2e test (provider-harness.json) and the Haiku 4.5 streaming regression test are not mentioned in Changes, even though the file is in the changeset. The author also did not add a screenshot section, which is correct for a non-UI change but is not stated. **Resolution** Optional improvements: add the e2e harness test (tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json) to the Changes list. Add a Security considerations entry, even if it reads 'None'. Complete the Checklist. State the expected outcome of go test for the How to test section.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#9538`] requires `message_start.message` on `/bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream` to include `stop_reason` and `stop_sequence` as JSON null. The whole-PR diff (merge base to head) of `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` adds `"stop_reason": nil` and `"stop_sequence": nil` to the `msgStart` literal map in `toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes`, with a comment. Go encodes nil map values as JSON null, so both keys are present and null. The `message_delta` branch is unchanged in this diff. The test `TestToAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes_MessageStartHasNullStopFields` (+26/-0 in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`) is supported by the change summary. Its contents were not re-read in this pass. The code requirement is met.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR changes are: `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` (the two nil-valued keys, confirmed by diff), `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go` (one regression test for the same keys, per summary), `core/changelog.md` (one Bedrock fix entry), and `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json` (+65/-0, one Bedrock streaming regression case that checks the same `message_start.message` fields, per summary). All of these support [`#9538`]. No change to `message_start.usage` ([`#5885`]) or to the `message_delta` branch is listed. The diff for the e2e JSON file could not be read because changed blobs were missing from the checkout. This conclusion for that file rests on the change summary, which reports only additions. The merged `dev` entries noted in the PR comments are not visible as deletions in that summary. No unrelated change is identified.
Full details: Audit Commit Point

**Explanation** The check applies only to changed handlers under transports/bifrost-http/handlers/. The reviewed range (refs/coderabbit/pre-merge-check/base..head) changes four files: core/changelog.md, core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go, core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go, and tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json. A path-filtered diff of transports/bifrost-http/handlers/ returned no files. No handler changed, so the audit-commit-point condition does not apply. The PR's real change adds stop_reason and stop_sequence nil fields to the message_start map in toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes, which sits in the Bedrock provider package, not in a handler. The check is inapplicable, so it passes.
